answer: Each epoch a karst sinkhole opens under one wallet in a hundred, by headcount: every identity it funded must answer a live challenge within the epoch, or all die together and its ivory bonds — $50 each, locked in the reef — are slashed. A wallet with k puppets is k times likelier to be picked, and each new puppet raises both the odds and the stake. Wallets sharing a funding source count as one, so splitting labels dodges nothing. Forging 1,000 puppets risks $50,000 and needs 1,000 humans on call; an honest wallet holds one identity, one $50 bond, and a 1% audit it passes by existing.
